clips.title: The story
paras: In Thousand Needles, Melor Stonehoof sends you after a hyena whose pack terrorizes the wildlife. Steelsnap's hunt breaks with the usual reasons tauren take a life.

Tauren hunters take life for sustenance, honor, or wisdom from the Earthmother. Melor Stonehoof asks you to hunt Steelsnap for another reason. The hyena is seen as a threat to nature's balance, bringing senseless violence and fear instead of keeping the cycle of life.

Steelsnap roams the canyons of northern Thousand Needles, south of the centaur enclave at Camp E'thok. Fierce hyenas follow him, and together they attack the gentler wildlife on the canyon floor. Slaying Steelsnap and bringing back his rib will end his hold over the needles.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At times we hunt for food. At times we hunt for honor. And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.
But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things. It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.
The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens. He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.
Find Steelsnap, friend. Find him, and defeat him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: In defeating the creature Steelsnap, you have cleansed the Thousand Needles of a horrible taint.
And that, friend, is your lesson this day.
